title: Age-Period-Cohort Models & Lexis Diagrams
text:
Road safety and mobility outcomes change over time due to three distinct temporal drivers: * Age Effect: Biological, behavioral, or experiential variations across life stages. * Period Effect: External shocks affecting all age groups simultaneously (e.g., policy changes, pandemic lockdowns). * Cohort Effect: Generational differences shaped by shared historical exposure.


Show code
library(ggplot2)

# Placeholder Lexis grid
expand.grid(period = 2000:2020, age = 18:80) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = period, y = age)) +
  geom_tile(fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(
    title = "Lexis Framework Grid (GB Data)",
    x = "Period (Calendar Year)",
    y = "Age"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()





Sample Lexis grid showing temporal exposure distribution.
